market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.3m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Production was ~988 tb/d in March 2026 per OPEC MOMR (secondary). April exports peaked at 1.23m bpd, but actual OPEC-reported production typically lags exports during inventory draws. 1,300 tb/d would be a level Venezuela has not reached since ~2017 and would require continued Chevron-driven gains plus stable infrastructure for ~32% growth from current. Possible but not the base case in 2026.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether infrastructure can scale to 1.3m; sanctions stability through Q4 2026.
